verdict.rationale: Shopify POS itself is documented as an iOS/Android-only app, so there is no evidence it can run headlessly. The surrounding developer tooling offers only adjacent automation: Shopify CLI scaffolds POS UI extensions, extensions can call the GraphQL Admin API via fetch(), and Shopify Flow powers threshold-based notifications. missing for 10: a documented headless or non-interactive mode for POS operations, CI pipeline usage (e.g. a CLI deploy or test flow in CI), API-driven automation of POS workflows outside the app UI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
